headline: Executive order closes federal agencies on December 24, 2020, giving most federal workers Christmas Eve off.
what_it_does: This order closes the executive departments and agencies of the federal government on Thursday, December 24, 2020, the day before Christmas. Orders like this usually give most federal employees a paid day off. They also usually let agency leaders keep some offices open or require some workers to report for national security, defense, or other public needs.

who_it_affects.how: Most executive branch workers get December 24, 2020 off from work, though some may still be required to work.

who_it_affects.group: People who use federal offices and services
who_it_affects.how: Many federal offices may be closed or have limited service on December 24, 2020.
